Verses.VerseAr: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِىۡ بِيَدِهِ الۡمُلۡكُ وَهُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Blessed is He in Whose (Mighty) Hand is the Kingdom (of all the worlds). And He enjoys Perfect Command over everything;

Verses.VerseAr: اۨلَّذِىۡ خَلَقَ الۡمَوۡتَ وَالۡحَيٰوةَ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ اَيُّكُمۡ اَحۡسَنُ عَمَلًا  ؕ وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡغَفُوۡرُۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He Who has created death and life (so that) He may test you as to which of you is best in conduct. And He is Almighty, Most Forgiving;

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ طِبَاقًا‌ؕ مَا تَرٰى فِىۡ خَلۡقِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ مِنۡ تَفٰوُتٍ‌ؕ فَارۡجِعِ الۡبَصَرَۙ هَلۡ تَرٰى مِنۡ فُطُوۡرٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He Who has created seven (or numerous) heavenly spheres corresponding to one another (layer upon layer). You will not find any irregularity and disproportion in the system of the creation of the Most Kind (Lord). So have a (meditative and thoughtful) look around: do you find in this (Creation) any incongruity or disharmony (i.e. degeneration or falling apart)?

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ ارۡجِعِ الۡبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيۡنِ يَنۡقَلِبۡ اِلَيۡكَ الۡبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَّهُوَ حَسِيۡرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Look around time and again with (an inquisitive) vision (from different angles and with scientific methods. Every time) your sight will return to you fatigued and frustrated (in finding any shortcoming or imperfection).

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـقَدۡ زَيَّـنَّا السَّمَآءَ الدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَابِيۡحَ وَجَعَلۡنٰهَا رُجُوۡمًا لِّلشَّيٰطِيۡنِ‌ وَاَعۡتَدۡنَا لَهُمۡ عَذَابَ السَّعِيۡرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely We have adorned the lowest heaven of the universe with lights (in the form of stars, planets, other asteroids and meteoroids). And We have also made (some of them) the means of pelting away (i.e. eliminating the negative effects of) satans (i.e. rebellious forces). And We have prepared for these (satans) a torment of Blazing Fire.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلِلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِرَبِّهِمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ‌ؕ وَبِئۡسَ الۡمَصِيۡرُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And for those who have denied their Lord is the torment of Hell. And what an evil abode it is!

Verses.VerseAr: اِذَاۤ اُلۡقُوۡا فِيۡهَا سَمِعُوۡا لَهَا شَهِيۡقًا وَّهِىَ تَفُوۡرُۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: When they will be flung into it they will hear its horrifying roar. And that (Fire) will be boiling (with rage),

Verses.VerseAr: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الۡغَيۡظِ‌ؕ كُلَّمَاۤ اُلۡقِىَ فِيۡهَا فَوۡجٌ سَاَلَهُمۡ خَزَنَـتُهَاۤ اَلَمۡ يَاۡتِكُمۡ نَذِيۡرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: As if it is about to burst into pieces with intense wrath. When a group will be cast into it, its guards will ask them: ‘Did no Warner come to you?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا بَلٰى قَدۡ جَآءَنَا نَذِيۡرٌ ۙ فَكَذَّبۡنَا وَقُلۡنَا مَا نَزَّلَ اللّٰهُ مِنۡ شَىۡءٍ   ۖۚ اِنۡ اَنۡتُمۡ اِلَّا فِىۡ ضَلٰلٍ كَبِيۡرٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will say: ‘Yes indeed! A Warner did come to us but we rejected him and said: Allah has not sent down anything. You are just in great error.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالُوۡا لَوۡ كُنَّا نَسۡمَعُ اَوۡ نَعۡقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىۡۤ اَصۡحٰبِ السَّعِيۡرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they will say: ‘Had we listened to or understood (the Truth), we would not have been (put) among the inmates of Hell (today).’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاعۡتَرَفُوۡا بِذَنۡۢبِهِمۡ‌ۚ فَسُحۡقًا لِّاَصۡحٰبِ السَّعِيۡرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then they will confess their sin. So remoteness for the inmates of Hell (from Allah’s Mercy) is (destined).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ بِالۡغَيۡبِ لَهُمۡ مَّغۡفِرَةٌ وَّاَجۡرٌ كَبِيۡرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely those who fear their Lord unseen, for them is forgiveness and great reward.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَسِرُّوۡا قَوۡلَـكُمۡ اَوِ اجۡهَرُوۡا بِهٖؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيۡمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوۡرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And whether you speak in secret or aloud, certainly He knows best (even) the things (hidden) in the hearts.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَا يَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ خَلَقَؕ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيۡفُ الۡخَبِيۡرُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Does He, Who has created, not know? In truth He is the One Who can see the essence and is Well Aware (of everything).

Verses.VerseAr: هُوَ الَّذِىۡ جَعَلَ لَـكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ ذَلُوۡلاً فَامۡشُوۡا فِىۡ مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوۡا مِنۡ رِّزۡقِهٖ‌ؕ وَاِلَيۡهِ النُّشُوۡرُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He is the One Who has made the earth soft and subservient to you. So walk about through its tracks and eat of the sustenance (given) by Him and towards Him alone is the return, rising (after death).

Verses.VerseAr: ءَاَمِنۡتُمۡ مَّنۡ فِىۡ السَّمَآءِ اَنۡ يَّخۡسِفَ بِكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ فَاِذَا هِىَ تَمُوۡرُۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have you gone fearless of (the Lord of) the heaven that He may sink you into the earth when it suddenly shakes?

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ اَمِنۡتُمۡ مَّنۡ فِىۡ السَّمَآءِ اَنۡ يُّرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ حَاصِبًا‌ؕ فَسَتَعۡلَمُوۡنَ كَيۡفَ نَذِيۡرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have you gone fearless of (the Lord of) the heaven that He may send against you a stone-pelting wind? Then soon will you come to know how My Warning is!

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـقَدۡ كَذَّبَ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيۡرِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely those before them (also) denied. But how (awful did prove) My denial!

Verses.VerseAr: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اِلَى الطَّيۡرِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ صٰٓفّٰتٍ وَّيَقۡبِضۡنَؕؔ   ۘ مَا يُمۡسِكُهُنَّ اِلَّا الرَّحۡمٰنُ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ بِكُلِّ شَىۡءٍۢ بَصِيۡرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have they not seen the birds above them spreading out their wings and (sometimes) folding them? Nothing can hold them (from falling down in the air) except (the law made by) the Most Kind (Lord). Surely He sees everything best.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمَّنۡ هٰذَا الَّذِىۡ هُوَ جُنۡدٌ لَّكُمۡ يَنۡصُرُكُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ‌ؕ اِنِ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ اِلَّا فِىۡ غُرُوۡرٍ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Well, is there anyone that can muster an army to help you against the Most Kind Lord? The disbelievers are merely (snared) in deception.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمَّنۡ هٰذَا الَّذِىۡ يَرۡزُقُكُمۡ اِنۡ اَمۡسَكَ رِزۡقَهٗ‌ۚ بَل لَّجُّوۡا فِىۡ عُتُوٍّ وَّنُفُوۡرٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Well, is there anyone that can provide you sustenance if (Allah) holds back His sustenance (from you)? In fact they are adamantly fixed in rebellion and hatred (for Truth)

Verses.VerseAr: اَفَمَنۡ يَّمۡشِىۡ مُكِبًّا عَلٰى وَجۡهِهٖۤ اَهۡدٰٓى اَمَّنۡ يَّمۡشِىۡ سَوِيًّا عَلٰى صِراطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Is he who walks in prone position more rightly guided or he who walks upright on a straight path?

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ هُوَ الَّذِىۡۤ اَنۡشَاَكُمۡ وَجَعَلَ لَـكُمُ السَّمۡعَ وَالۡاَبۡصَارَ وَالۡاَفۡـِٕدَةَ  ‌ ؕ قَلِيۡلاً مَّا تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘(Allah) is He Who created you and provided you with ears and eyes and hearts. Yet you give thanks but little.’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ هُوَ الَّذِىۡ ذَرَاَكُمۡ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘He is the One Who has spread you in the earth and you will be gathered towards Him (on the Day of Assembly).’

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰى هٰذَا الۡوَعۡدُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they say: ‘When will this promise (of the Day of Resurrection) be fulfilled if you are truthful?’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ اِنَّمَا الۡعِلۡمُ عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ وَاِنَّمَاۤ اَنَا نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘The knowledge (of that Hour) is with Allah alone and I am just a clear Warner.’ (If the time is disclosed there will be no fear any more).

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا رَاَوۡهُ زُلۡفَةً سِیْٓــَٔتۡ وُجُوۡهُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَقِيۡلَ هٰذَا الَّذِىۡ كُنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ تَدَّعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then when they will see that (Day) near, the faces of the disbelievers will be deformed and turned black and it will be said (to them): ‘This is (the promise) which you asked for (to come to pass in haste).’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ اَهۡلَـكَنِىَ اللّٰهُ وَمَنۡ مَّعِىَ اَوۡ رَحِمَنَا ۙ فَمَنۡ يُّجِيۡرُ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ مِنۡ عَذَابٍ اَلِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘Well, give your view: if Allah causes me death (as you desire) and (also) to my companions, or shows Mercy to us (i.e. defers our death), then (in both these cases) who will shelter the disbelievers from the painful torment?’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ هُوَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ اٰمَنَّا بِهٖ وَعَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡنَا‌ۚ فَسَتَعۡلَمُوۡنَ مَنۡ هُوَ فِىۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘He alone is the Most Kind (Lord) in Whom we believe and in Whom we trust. So you will soon know who is in open error.’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ اَصۡبَحَ مَآؤُكُمۡ غَوۡرًا فَمَنۡ يَّاۡتِيۡكُمۡ بِمَآءٍ مَّعِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘If your water sinks far deep into the earth (i.e. dries up) then who will bring you flowing water (on earth)?’
